I am checking the Python environment inside the container.
I have resolved the issue by updating the MySQL backend to use the `database` and `password` connection parameters instead of the deprecated `db` and `passwd` kwargs:

- Updated [`DatabaseWrapper.get_connection_params()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-u3q2c2zb/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py#L194-L230) in [base.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-u3q2c2zb/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py) to set `kwargs['database']` and `kwargs['password']`.
- Updated [`DatabaseClient.settings_to_cmd_args_env()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-u3q2c2zb/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py#L8-L60) in [client.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-u3q2c2zb/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py) to check `'database'` in `OPTIONS` (falling back to `'db'` and `NAME`).
